The two separately scoped one-side tests detect the smaller clipped unmatched count, not just the larger. At width two the three possible pair types can always be matched, and width one is immediate. The disjoint profile counts sum to the stated cubic, and the clipped parameters attain the componentwise least admissible sizes. Minimum-order uniqueness is in the k>=3 classification, not at widths one and two. The strictness witnesses work, including the transition from two to three.
